limits: Presentation, source and layout review only; no new installed-hardware, controller or end-to-end timing qualification.
Device hierarchy is the known working inventory, including attached hardware and external interfaces. Unnumbered devices still need allocation; it is not an IP registry or approved bill of materials.
336 microTCA crates is the confirmed combined TDE + DAQ/timing count. No current subsystem split, PDU quantity or new I/O count is inferred.
Historical Detector 1 / HD counts and proposed thresholds in the EDMS export are not adopted for VD. Controller and bias-output variants remain distinct in the source review.
The archive contents were verified locally. The linked EDMS project was not authenticated as a live complete project listing; no latest-revision claim is made.
BMS maps remain service-boundary schematics; SDSTA interfaces, CUC allocation and several interlock choices remain proposals or open items.
Build uses local fonts. Recorded font/PDF-version warnings do not affect the inspected render.
